-- | Optional Prometheus exposition backend for the hermod-tracing system.
--   Exposes a minimal HTTP/TCP server that serves current EKG metrics in
--   the Prometheus text exposition format.
@package hermod-tracing-prometheus
@version 1.0.0

module Hermod.Tracing.Prometheus.Exposition
type MetricName = Text

-- | Converts Hermod's more permissive, internal metrics names to external
--   ones conforming to <a>https://prometheus.io/docs/practices/naming/</a>
--   The external metric name will be visible in the exposition.
asPrometheusMetricName :: MetricName -> MetricName
renderExpositionFromSample :: Bool -> Sample -> Text
renderExpositionFromSampleWith :: [(MetricName, Builder)] -> Bool -> Sample -> Text


-- | Run a TCP server, with hardening against connection flooding
module Hermod.Tracing.Prometheus.NetworkRun

-- | Parameters specifying how the TCP server should be run
data NetworkRunParams
NetworkRunParams :: !Int -> !Int -> !Int -> !Double -> !Int -> !Int -> !String -> NetworkRunParams

-- | Release socket after inactivity (seconds)
[runSocketTimeout] :: NetworkRunParams -> !Int

-- | Graceful closing of socket (milliseconds), 0 to disable
[runSocketGraceful] :: NetworkRunParams -> !Int

-- | Close socket if more than (runRecvMaxSize - 1) bytes received; choose
--   a small power of 2
[runRecvMaxSize] :: NetworkRunParams -> !Int

-- | Limit requests per second (may be &lt; 1.0), 0.0 to disable
[runRateLimit] :: NetworkRunParams -> !Double

-- | Limit total number of incoming connections, 0 to disable
[runConnLimitGlobal] :: NetworkRunParams -> !Int

-- | Limit number of incoming connections from the same host, 0 to disable
[runConnLimitPerHost] :: NetworkRunParams -> !Int

-- | The server name - exclusively used for labeling GHC threads
[runServerName] :: NetworkRunParams -> !String
type TimeoutServer a = NetworkRunParams -> IO () -> Socket -> IO a
defaultRunParams :: String -> NetworkRunParams

-- | Returns an IO action that will run a TCP server conforming to the run
--   parameters. Will bind to localhost / loopback device only if no host
--   name is specified. Will throw an exception when TCP server startup
--   fails - the caller is responsible for appropriately reacting to that.
mkTCPServerRunner :: NetworkRunParams -> Maybe HostName -> PortNumber -> TimeoutServer () -> IO (IO ())


-- | Run a simple Prometheus TCP server, responding *only* to the
--   '/metrics' URL with current Node metrics
module Hermod.Tracing.Prometheus.TCPServer

-- | Run a PrometheusSimple server with default DoS protection. Will retry
--   / restart Prometheus server when an exception occurs, in increasing
--   intervals.
runPrometheusSimple :: Tracer IO TracePrometheusSimple -> Store -> (Bool, Maybe HostName, PortNumber) -> IO (Async ())

-- | Run a PrometheusSimple server with default DoS protection, and don't
--   emit any traces. Will retry / restart Prometheus server when an
--   exception occurs, in increasing intervals.
runPrometheusSimpleSilent :: Store -> (Bool, Maybe HostName, PortNumber) -> IO (Async ())

-- | Run a PrometheusSimple server with custom DoS protection parameter
--   overrides. Will retry / restart Prometheus server when an exception
--   occurs, in increasing intervals.
runPrometheusSimpleWith :: PrometheusSimpleRun -> Tracer IO TracePrometheusSimple -> Store -> (Bool, Maybe HostName, PortNumber) -> IO (Async ())
data TracePrometheusSimple
TracePrometheusSimpleStart :: Word16 -> TracePrometheusSimple
[port] :: TracePrometheusSimple -> Word16
TracePrometheusSimpleStop :: String -> TracePrometheusSimple
[message] :: TracePrometheusSimple -> String
instance GHC.Show.Show Hermod.Tracing.Prometheus.TCPServer.TracePrometheusSimple
instance GHC.Classes.Eq Hermod.Tracing.Prometheus.TCPServer.Method
instance GHC.Classes.Eq Hermod.Tracing.Prometheus.TCPServer.Accept
instance Hermod.Tracing.Types.LogFormatting Hermod.Tracing.Prometheus.TCPServer.TracePrometheusSimple
